facts.value: The subsystem maintains a two-record rolling state. During a frame, timing setters overwrite their respective fields and instrumentation counters accumulate in HSD_PerfCurrentStat. At the end of the frame, HSD_PerfInitStat atomically at source level promotes that completed record to HSD_PerfLastStat and resets every current timing and counter field to zero. The next frame establishes a new start_time before accumulating another record.
facts.rationale: The current globals and setters preserve the accumulating current state, while struct assignment followed by whole-record clearing preserves the completed-to-last transition. The main-loop ordering establishes a new baseline before measured work and rotates the record after total-time capture.

evidence.why: Shows persistent current and last records, timing and counter updates, and the copy-then-clear transition.
